Ethan / Claire —

Congrats on closing — really excited to partner. I’m attaching the initial MAP ("Skyline_MAP_v1.2.pdf") and a tentative canary cadence sheet. Quick summary below; full plan in the attachment.

1) Timeline (high level)
   - Week 1 (July 9–13): Pre-provisioning + security evidence handoff
   - Week 2 (July 16–20): Sandbox validation and training for product ops (trainer-led)
   - Week 3 (July 23–27): Canary run #1 (10% traffic, monitoring gates)
   - Week 4 (Aug 6–10): Canary run #2 + staggered ramp if gates pass

2) Owners (Redwood / Skyline) — see MAP; owners listed against each milestone.

3) Training approach
   - One 90-min trainer session (recorded) + two 45-min role-specific breakouts (CS/ops, SRE)
   - Pre-training checklist for attendees (access, sample queries, acceptance prompts)

4) Evaluation plan (quality gates)
   - Latency percentile targets and token-cost budget per session
   - Regression testing against a fixed prompt set; baseline results attached

5) Compliance / evidence
   - We'll provide the SOC2 evidence bundle and audit log export (redacted) by July 10

Marissa — can you validate the trainer roster availability and confirm which two SRE leads we should invite?
Karthik — please add the canary instrumentation checklist and confirm whether we should use sticky routing for the first run.

Next steps: I’ll upload the MAP and schedule a 30-minute alignment call for Wednesday 6/22 to finalize owners. If that works for you both, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Accounts (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-signature kickoff: MAP alignment + critical dates

Team —

Recommendation on routing for Canary #1: use stateless sticky routing at the application layer (route by session id) for a 10% cohort. Reasons: 
- Faster signal for user-facing regressions (keeps experiments consistent per user)
- Observability: we can track KV cache hit rates and per-session latency variance

Instrumentation checklist (short):
- Enable per-request tracing (trace-id header)
- Prefix cache warm-up with a synthetic prompt set (attached in MAP)
- Configure alerting: 95th p50 latency spike, token consumption > 120% of budget, error-rate > 1%

I can prep the canary runbook and a short run-debrief template. I’ll post on Drive and link it in the MAP.

Karthik
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
